ELESIS-COUNTER_ATTACK_POWER.title: Counter Attack
ELESIS-COUNTER_ATTACK_POWER.description: When attacked, deal {Power} damage back to the attacker once for each hit received.
ELESIS-COUNTER_ATTACK_POWER.smartDescrip: When attacked, deal {Power} damage back to the attacker once for each hit received.
ELESIS-BURN_POWER.title: Burn
ELESIS-BURN_POWER.description: Before this monster acts, it takes {Power} damage, then loses half of its Burn, rounded up.
ELESIS-BURN_POWER.smartDescription: Before this monster acts, it takes {Power} damage, then loses half of its Burn, rounded up.
